title: Isolation of Monocytes from Whole Blood With Magnetic Negative Sorting
author: Brandt D Pence
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.kwtcxen
materials: Materials to Prepare: **Isolation Buffer**: 1 mM EDTA in phosphate-buffered saline (PBS): -Add 2 ml 0.5 M EDTA to a 1 L bottle of sterile PBS. -Maintain sterility. -Store at room temperature. -Usable at least 6 months. **Media** -Various media can be used, depending on downstream assay. -For counting using a Scepter cell counter (Millipore), serum-free medium is necessary.

steps.title: Collect and Prepare Blood
steps.instruction: Collect blood into K2EDTA vacutainer tubes, invert several times, and store at room temperature (RT) until use.

steps.title: Aliquot Blood
steps.instruction: Aliquot 4 ml of whole blood into each 14 ml tube.

steps.title: Prepare Reagents
steps.instruction: Vortex the reagents from the monocyte isolation kit.

substeps.instruction: Vortex RapidSpheres (brown reagent) for 15-30 seconds.
Vortex isolation cocktail (clear reagent) for 5 seconds.

steps.title: First Labeling and Incubation
steps.instruction: Add labeling reagents to the blood and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 μl RapidSpheres and 200 μl isolation cocktail to each 14 ml tube.
Pulse vortex tubes 5-10 times to mix.
Incubate for 5 min at room temperature.

steps.title: First Magnetic Separation
steps.instruction: Perform the first round of magnetic depletion.

substeps.instruction: Add 8 ml isolation buffer to each tube and invert 5 times to mix (hold cap tightly).
Move tubes to magnet and incubate for 5 min at room temperature.
Remove supernatant by pipetting and transfer to a new 14 ml tube, including ~0.5 ml of red blood cells for best yield.

steps.title: Second Labeling and Incubation
steps.instruction: Repeat the labeling process on the transferred supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 μl RapidSpheres and 200 μl isolation cocktail to each 14 ml tube.
Invert 5 times to mix (hold cap tightly).
Incubate for 5 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Second Magnetic Separation
steps.instruction: Perform the second round of magnetic depletion to remove remaining red blood cells.

substeps.instruction: Move tubes to magnet and incubate for at least 5 minutes (10 minutes is recommended for improved RBC removal) at room temperature.
Remove the clarified yellow supernatant by pipetting and transfer to a new 14 ml tube without disturbing the red blood cells.

steps.title: Final Magnetic Wash
steps.instruction: Perform a final magnetic incubation to ensure purity.

substeps.instruction: Move the new tubes directly to the magnet and incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Transfer for Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to tubes suitable for centrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Remove supernatant by pipetting and transfer to centrifuge tubes (e.g., 5 ml tubes, 3 per 14 ml tube).
Do not remove or disturb the residual red blood cells forming a thin line on the back of the tube.

steps.title: Pellet Cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the cells to concentrate them.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 500 × g for 5 min in a refrigerated centrifuge (4-8°C).

steps.title: Resuspend Cells
steps.instruction: Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in prepared media or buffer.

substeps.instruction: Use a volume of 75-100 μl of media per 1 ml of initial blood processed (targeting a final concentration of 4-6 × 10^6 cells/ml).
Optional: If red blood cells are visible in the pellet, perform a red blood cell lysis step.

steps.title: Count and Verify Cells
steps.instruction: Count the cells and verify purity.

substeps.instruction: Count cells using routine methods (e.g., Scepter counter with 40 μm sensor, diluting 10× in serum-free media: 20 μl cells in 180 μl media).
Verify cell purity using a flow cytometer with an anti-CD14 antibody.
